description: Work with your Fireblocks workspace: create and manage vault accounts and deposit addresses, check balances, start, follow and cancel transfers, estimate fees, and manage whitelisted wallets, with triggers for new transactions, status changes and new vault accounts.

fireblocks_balance_changed_trigger.description: Runs when the total balance of an asset in a vault account changes, with the new balance. It compares each look with the last, so several changes between looks start one run.

output.available: How much of it can be spent now.
output.locked: How much is held for transactions under way.
output.total: The asset's total balance in the vault account.

parameters.description: Only this vault account. Leave blank for every vault account.
parameters.name: vault_account_id

parameters.description: Only this asset, by its Fireblocks asset id such as BTC. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_id

fireblocks_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each new transaction in the workspace, incoming or outgoing, with its asset, amount, source and destination. Transactions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.amount: The amount, in the asset's own units.
output.amount_usd: The amount in US dollars, when Fireblocks knows it.
output.asset_id: The asset moved, such as BTC.
output.destination_address: The blockchain address it goes to.
output.destination_type: Where it goes, such as VAULT_ACCOUNT or ONE_TIME_ADDRESS.
output.external_tx_id: Your own reference for it, if one was given.
output.operation: What it does, such as TRANSFER or CONTRACT_CALL.
output.source_id: The source's id, such as the vault account's.
output.source_type: Where it comes from, such as VAULT_ACCOUNT or EXTERNAL_WALLET.
output.status: Its status, such as SUBMITTED, COMPLETED or FAILED.
output.sub_status: More detail on the status, such as CONFIRMED or INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.
output.tx_hash: The blockchain transaction hash, once broadcast.

parameters.description: Only transactions of this asset, by its Fireblocks asset id such as BTC. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.description: Only transactions leaving this vault account, by its id. Leave blank for any source.
parameters.name: source_vault_account_id

parameters.description: Only transactions arriving in this vault account, by its id, such as deposits. Leave blank for any destination.
parameters.name: destination_vault_account_id

fireblocks_new_vault_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new vault account in the workspace, with its name and assets. Vault accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.assets: Its assets with their balances, often none yet.
output.auto_fuel: Whether the gas station tops up its gas.
output.customer_ref_id: Its AML customer reference, if it has one.
output.hidden_on_ui: Whether it is hidden in the Console.
output.name: Its name.

fireblocks_new_whitelisted_address_trigg.description: Runs when an address is added to a whitelisted external or internal wallet, with its approval status. Addresses already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.asset_id: The address's asset, such as BTC.
output.status: Its approval status, such as WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL or APPROVED.
output.tag: Its tag or memo, if it has one.

parameters.description: Which whitelisted wallets to watch: external (the default), internal or both.
parameters.name: wallet_type

fireblocks_transaction_status_changed_tr.description: Runs each time a transaction's status changes, such as to Completed or Failed, or only when it reaches the status you choose. A new transaction's first status counts as a change.

output.amount: The amount, in the asset's own units.
output.amount_usd: The amount in US dollars, when Fireblocks knows it.
output.asset_id: The asset moved, such as BTC.
output.destination_address: The blockchain address it goes to.
output.destination_type: Where it goes, such as VAULT_ACCOUNT or ONE_TIME_ADDRESS.
output.external_tx_id: Your own reference for it, if one was given.
output.operation: What it does, such as TRANSFER or CONTRACT_CALL.
output.source_id: The source's id, such as the vault account's.
output.source_type: Where it comes from, such as VAULT_ACCOUNT or EXTERNAL_WALLET.
output.status: Its status, such as SUBMITTED, COMPLETED or FAILED.
output.sub_status: More detail on the status, such as CONFIRMED or INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.
output.tx_hash: The blockchain transaction hash, once broadcast.

parameters.description: Only when a transaction reaches this status, such as COMPLETED, FAILED, REJECTED, BLOCKED, CANCELLED or PENDING_AUTHORIZATION. Leave blank for every change.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only transactions of this asset, by its Fireblocks asset id such as BTC. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_id

fireblocks_vault_asset_added_trigger.description: Runs when a vault account gets a wallet for a new asset, with its balance. Assets already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.available: How much of it can be spent now.
output.locked: How much is held for transactions under way.
output.total: The asset's total balance in the vault account.

parameters.description: Only this vault account. Leave blank for every vault account.
parameters.name: vault_account_id

parameters.description: Only this asset, by its Fireblocks asset id such as BTC. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_id
